python3 - <<'PY'
import csv
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from pathlib import Path
batch=list(csv.DictReader(Path('/workspace/northstar-lab-batch-17.csv').open()))
cal={r['metric']:Decimal(r['multiplier']) for r in csv.DictReader(Path('/workspace/northstar-calibration-17.csv').open())}
for metric in ('hgb_raw','glucose_raw'):
    vals=[Decimal(r[metric])*cal[metric] for r in batch]
    mean=sum(vals)/len(vals)
    print(metric, 'sum raw', sum(Decimal(r[metric]) for r in batch), 'mean converted exact',mean,'rounded',mean.quantize(Decimal('0.01'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
print('records',len(batch))
PY
